author: Epic Games
description:
Witness a preview of the next Warframe update, featuring voiceover from actor Choi Han!  

Atop the Yuvan Peak, where the Tenno mastered their Void powers, an icy monolith rises. Use its strength to beat back a new threat: the Entropic Eximus. Master the keen blade of the first female ice-themed Warframe, Narin. Defend and strike deftly with her swift rapier and deadly Abilities starting September 23.  

Engage in new six-player Glacial Defiance Missions and aid Cephalon Melica as you return to the Zariman once more!  Instantly add a free Banshee Warframe when you log in after launch for a limited time until October 7.  

Iceblade of Narin arrives on September 23! https://epic.gm/warframe
title: Warframe | Iceblade of Narin Official Gameplay Trailer | Coming September 23!

author: Epic Games
description:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword, the all new entry in Capcom's swordplay action series, is available now! https://epic.gm/onimusha-wots

Become the Onimusha, Miyamoto Musashi, and prepare yourself for the intense duels that await! Demo available now! Experience the exhilarating swordplay action and earn yourself the save data bonus!

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Powers to pull off superhuman feats. All these elements combine to deliver an unprecedented swordplay action experience you will not want to miss.  ©CAPCOM
